overview: A Mid Rim industrial world known for Ubrikkian Industries repulsorcraft and shipyards.
history:
Ubrikkia appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Ubrikkia shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Ubrikkia remains a reference point in Mid Rim Territories surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
notableEvents: Surveyed during the Old Republic expansion into Mid Rim Territories
Referenced in Clone Wars and Imperial era records
Documented in Knights of the Old Republic archives
Listed in Old Sith Empire star charts

timeline.event: First major settlement era on Ubrikkia
